exposure: Dexmedetomidine combined with lumbar epidural anesthesia
cohort: The study included 60 full-term pregnant females with an American Society of Anesthesiologists grade I or II undergoing caesarean section.
finding: Dexmedetomidine combined with lumbar epidural anesthesia significantly reduced maternal VAS scores, adverse reactions, traction response, and Th1 cytokines (IL-2, TNF-a) while increasing Th2 cytokines (IL-4, IL-10) in both mothers and neonates, with no difference in neonatal Apgar scores.
